answer: Duplicating identities then requires acquiring new samples and re-registering, making each sybil cost real resources plus verification fees. One concrete mechanism: mandate each agent to stake a unique, costly-to-forge credential bound to a scarce physical resource, like a verified pigment sample from a registered oasis site, logged in a shared atlas of provenance. Honest agents pay once; attackers pay repeatedly, so the marginal cost of fake identities scales linearly and deters mass registration. In practice, Agent0276 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
